D.t: Hannah Pingree leads by 13.5 in the forecast and wins 99% of simulations. The cushion is about 100,307 votes; a one point swing is about 3,704 voters changing sides.
In 8 of 10 simulations the result lands between D +5.9 and D +20.9. Only an unusual polling error changes the winner.
The polls page average is D +11.0. Your best recent poll is Maine People's Resource Center (D) at D +14.3; your worst is Marist College at R +2.0. 15 polls in the last 30 days.

The biggest vote banks for Democrats: Cumberland, a projected net 80,720 votes; York, a projected net 23,372 votes; Hancock, a projected net 6,724 votes. Every point of extra turnout here is worth more than persuasion anywhere else.
The large counties within 12 points: Penobscot, R +6.4, 10.4% of the vote; Kennebec, D +1.8, 8.9% of the vote; Androscoggin, R +2.3, 7.1% of the vote; Oxford, R +7.8, 4.1% of the vote.

D.h: Where you run behind the 2024 map
D.t: Against the 2024 presidential vote, Hannah Pingree runs furthest behind in Aroostook, Piscataquis, Androscoggin. That is where the forecast sees voters who backed your side two years ago and have not come back yet.

Groups big enough to move the race: White voters, 95% of voters, 52 to 41, where a 5 point gain is worth 4.75 points; Voters who cast ballots in 2022 and 2024, 77% of voters, 54 to 39, where a 5 point gain is worth 3.84 points; Voters without a degree, 60% of voters, 49 to 44, where a 5 point gain is worth 3.02 points.
The forecast's worst groups for Hannah Pingree: Immigration voters 20 to 73, Midsize counties 48 to 45, Men 48 to 45. Cutting the loss here is often cheaper than winning new groups.
$1.2M cash against $395K. Spend it early on persuasion television in the battleground counties and keep a reserve for the last week.
Registered Democrats cast 47% of the 290,377 ballots in Maine so far, against 23% for the other party. That is 2.0 points worse for Democrats than the forecast expected by now.

D.h: What the ballots so far say
D.t: The early vote has moved this forecast 0.2 points away from Hannah Pingree. Election Day has to make it up: the remaining vote must break harder your way than the forecast expects.
Activity: 4 campaign stops by the candidate or surrogates in 30 days.

R.t: Against the 2024 presidential vote, Bobby Charles runs furthest behind in York, Cumberland, Hancock. That is where the forecast sees voters who backed your side two years ago and have not come back yet.

The forecast's worst groups for Bobby Charles: Large counties 24 to 70, Health care and Social Security voters 26 to 67, Corruption voters 26 to 67. Cutting the loss here is often cheaper than winning new groups.
